description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing River Kelpie.
When River Kelpie dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
When River Kelpie enters, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
